g.text: Cut SHLD/SHLD1 jumper to disconnect USB Shields from Ground.

Total Copper Thickness: 1.4mil / 36um Material: FR-4 STD Er:4.6 Conductor Width: 8mil / 0.2032mm Conductor Spacing: 5mil / 0.127mm JLC-7628 Prepreg dielectric thickness: 0.1803mm (7.1mil) 4-LAYER Zdifferential: 90.9 Ohms
Cut respective jumper to sever power to LED.
Cut I2C jumper to remove pullups.
